name: Advance Petrochemicals Ltd.
about: Advance Petrochemicals Ltd. manufactures and sells petroleum products in India. The company offers ethanol amines, alkyl alkanolamines, non-ionic surfactants, oil field chemicals, polyethylene glycols, acrylic and co-acrylic binder glycol ethers, auxiliaries and specialty chemical hydraulic brake fluids, surface active agents, solvents, alkyl aryl ethanolamines, ethanolamines, glycols, ethylene oxide derivatives, amines, antifreeze coolant-radiator coolants, coolant-submersibles, and demulsifier-emulsion breakers. It also provides diethylene glycol monobutyl ethers, diethylene glycol monoethyl ethers, diethylene glycol monomethyl ethers, ethylene glycol monobutyl ethers, ethylene glycol monoethyl ethers, ethylene glycol monomethyl ethers, fuel system icing inhibitors, ethoxylate nonyl phenols, ethoxylate castor and ethoxylate coconut oils, mono methyl ethanolamines, N-methyl diethanolamines, plasma-torch coolants, and triethanolamine products. The company exports its products. It serves the textile, agrochemicals, detergents, pharmaceuticals, personal care, oil field, automotive, paint and coating, aircraft, automobile, refinery, mineral oil, pesticide, leather, paper, and manmade fabric industries. Its products are used in aviation fuel, and passenger and commercial vehicles. Advance Petrochemicals Ltd. was founded in 1984 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
